# Social preview source

The repository preview is rendered at 1280×640 from three lossless sources:

- `background.png`: the generated abstract system-telemetry artwork.
- the repository's canonical `icon.svg` monitor mark.
- deterministic SVG typography and layout generated by `render.py`.
- output copy and repository-relative paths from `variants.json`.

The committed output is `.github/social-preview.png`. Render it with:

```console
make social-preview
```

Verify that the committed PNG still matches its sources with:

```console
make check-social-preview
```

The background was generated specifically for Adaptive System Monitor with
the built-in ImageGen tool and this prompt:

> Use case: stylized-concept
>
> Asset type: GitHub repository social-preview background, final 1280x640
> landscape composition.
>
> Primary request: Create a premium abstract technology backdrop for an
> open-source Cinnamon desktop applet named Adaptive System Monitor. The
> artwork should evoke calm, trustworthy real-time system telemetry: CPU
> waveform traces, memory and temperature signals, compact monitoring data,
> and a subtle vertical panel rhythm.
>
> Scene/backdrop: deep near-black graphite and midnight blue atmosphere. Keep
> the entire left 54 percent calm, dark, spacious, and low-detail for
> deterministic branding overlay. On the right 46 percent, create an elegant
> luminous telemetry composition with layered flowing waveform lines, a refined
> circular monitoring dial, a few small data points, and a restrained lower-right
> row of vertical signal bars.
>
> Style/medium: refined cinematic 3D abstract digital artwork, glassy light,
> crisp vector-like telemetry traces, sophisticated open-source desktop product
> branding, restrained and premium, excellent readability at thumbnail size.
>
> Constraints: background art only; no text, letters, numbers, logos, icons,
> screenshots, UI panels, people, or watermark; preserve a clean dark left
> field; do not imitate the ChatGPT Usage or Proton Drive artwork.
